versions.changelog: v1.0.9 - brand promo link updated to https://www.xiaoyaosai.com/ (docs-only change: SKILL.md bilingual promo line; no behavior change).

v1.0.8 - PDF helpers no longer resolve symlinked sources: the source PDF must live on a real path, and any symlink in the path (file or directory) is refused outright (exit 2) instead of being followed, with the real location echoed back. Documentation aligned (SKILL.md, manifest.json, READMEs, references/pdf_reading.md).

v1.0.7 - read side is now bounded exactly like the write side: any entry whose real path escapes the knowledge-base root (symlinked files or folders) is skipped and counted instead of being read (pathguard.read_within, search_kb.py, build_index.py). PDF helpers resolve the source to its real path and print it. Boundary docs updated (SKILL.md, manifest.json, both READMEs); removed a stale unguarded script copy from references/pdf_reading.md.

v1.0.6 fixes the ClawHub v1.0.5 review findings: (1) removed the HTML comment from templates/data_structure.md that was flagged as hidden instructions; (2) unified the write-scope wording across SKILL.md, references/pdf_reading.md and the index template so docs match the realpath-enforced scripts (PDF-derived .txt and page PNGs stay inside the knowledge base, no system temp directory); (3) declared the bilingual hero artwork and the skill's language-optional policy in SKILL.md and in the SVG description. No code changes.

Security: writes can no longer escape the knowledge-base root through symlinks. A new scripts/pathguard.py resolves every write target to its real path and refuses anything that lands outside the knowledge-base root (fail closed, exit 2), and symlinked folders are never traversed by build_index.py. Applied to index generation, PDF->txt extraction and the optional PDF->image/OCR path. Docs made consistent: all three write operations are now enumerated in SKILL.md, both READMEs and manifest.json, index generation carries a prominent disk-write warning, activation is narrowed with explicit non-examples, and the language policy is documented (sample text stays Chinese, index headings stay English). No new permissions, no network access, no files deleted.
Docs only: replaced the XiaoyaoClaw promo line in SKILL.md with a bilingual XiaoyaoAI promo block (Chinese + English, project.xiaoyaosai.com). No functional, script, or metadata changes.

Security review fixes (13 findings). Command injection (aig T09, error): the retrieval templates interpolated user keywords and paths into shell strings. Added scripts/search_kb.py as the preferred path - keywords and directories are passed as argv so no shell parsing occurs, matching is literal rather than regex, hits, per-file size and scope are bounded, and nothing is written - and documented three rules for the raw shell fallback (variable-first, -SimpleMatch / grep -F with -LiteralPath, never iex/eval/sh -c, and never user text in structural positions). Optional dependencies are pinned exactly in requirements-optional.txt (pdfplumber 0.11.10, pypdf 6.19.0, pypdfium2 5.13.0, pandas 3.0.5, openpyxl 3.1.5; the OCR group is pinned too) with a mandatory pre-install confirmation and an explicit note that upgrades require editing that file. The description now states the two optional write operations (index generation, PDF-to-text) and their trigger conditions; a read/write scope section documents that retrieval is read-only, writes need an explicit request plus confirmation, stay inside the knowledge base root and never delete files; allowed-tools and a manifest permissions block were added. The scripts gained containment checks (derived .txt beside the source PDF, image output inside the source tree, index writes verified with commonpath) and write disclosures, and language notes were added across references and scripts.

- Removed the documentation file `skill-card.md`.
- SKILL.md clarified that core retrieval is zero-dependency; PDF/Excel processing now explicitly requires on-demand pip package installation, with user notification and confirmation required.
- Added explicit section on ability scope and write-operation boundaries: only specific scripts may perform writes, and only as needed or if user explicitly requests.
- Strengthened statements on user privacy, no modification of source files, and non-networked operation.
- Clarified that all write operations produce outputs only in temporary/user-specified locations, which can be cleaned up.
- Improved instructions on informing users before installing any Python dependencies for advanced features.

xiaoyaoclaw-kb-retriever 1.0.1

- Removed auxiliary and documentation files, including LICENSE, all README variants, manifest.json, assets, and docs.
- No changes to core functionality or the main SKILL.md logic.
- The package now contains only essential implementation components.
